title: Design of Carbon Capture Processes Under Part-load Operating Conditions
summary: Solvent-based carbon capture can reduce CO2 emissions resulting from a continued reliance on fossil power plants for firm power. These capture processes remove CO2 from flue gases via a solvent. Careful design via process systems optimization can limit the overall cost of carbon capture, which is both capital- and energy intensive. As dispatchable power plants operate to meet varying load demand, the design process needs to account for varying operating points.
